title: The Erased Mark
teaser: The third night of the Grand Magic Games. Fairy Tail is staying at the Honey Bone inn in Crocus, and after a street brawl the guards won't let any guild out the door until morning. At 02:20 Happy, the guild's winged cat, was found in the ice cellar under the kitchen. A basket of fresh fish stood next to him, and he hadn't touched a single one. The guild mark on his back has been erased, as if Happy had been expelled from Fairy Tail.

habits.label: Strips without noticing
habits.habit: Doesn't notice when they've ended up without a shirt
clues: Someone's shirt was dropped on the steps to the ice cellar, and the innkeeper doesn't recognise it. The culprit strips without noticing.
The night porter saw a shirtless man by the ice cellar door and assumed it was someone from Fairy Tail. The culprit strips without noticing.

habits.label: Chews iron
habits.habit: Snacks on nails and bolts like crackers
clues: Two nails are missing from the ice cellar door, and a gnawed nail head lies on the threshold. The culprit chews iron.
The iron bracket on the crate next to Happy has clear tooth marks. The culprit chews iron.

habits.label: Dried fish in the pocket
habits.habit: Always carries a dried fish in their pocket
clues: A dried fish tail lies between the crates, though the ice cellar holds only fresh fish. The culprit carries dried fish.
The cook was surprised that in the night the stairs to the ice cellar smelled of dried fish. The culprit carries dried fish.

habits.label: Strawberry cake
habits.habit: Can't get through a day without a slice of strawberry cake
clues: A strawberry in cream is squashed on a step down to the ice cellar. The culprit loves strawberry cake.
In the night the last slice of strawberry cake went missing from the kitchen, and the empty plate turned up in the ice cellar. The culprit loves strawberry cake.

habits.label: Wears armour
habits.habit: Doesn't take off their armour even at the inn
clues: The stone floor of the ice cellar has fresh dents from armoured boots. The culprit wears armour.
In the night the porter heard iron clanking on the stairs, as if someone were going down in armour. The culprit wears armour.

habits.label: Bets on the bouts
habits.habit: Bets money on every bout of the Games
clues: A crumpled bookmaker's slip with a bet on tomorrow's bout lies next to Happy. The culprit bets on the Games.
A sheet totting up betting winnings was found in Happy's bag, and the handwriting isn't his. The culprit bets on the Games.

habits.label: Cowboy hat
habits.habit: Never takes off a cowboy hat, day or night
clues: A scrap of felt torn from the brim of a cowboy hat is left on a nail by the ice cellar door. The culprit wears a cowboy hat.
The frost on the fish crate has the round mark of a wide brim: someone put a hat down there. The culprit wears a cowboy hat.

habits.label: Wooden dolls
habits.habit: Carries wooden dolls on their belt and talks to them
clues: The broken-off arm of a little wooden doll was found under the fish crate. The culprit carries wooden dolls.
The porter heard a whisper behind the ice cellar door: "Quiet, little ones, quiet." The culprit carries wooden dolls.

habits.label: Star chart
habits.habit: Checks a star chart before deciding anything
clues: A worn star chart with notes for tonight was dropped by the stairs. The culprit carries a star chart.
A constellation is scratched on a crate in the ice cellar, with a time next to it: "02:00". The culprit carries a star chart.

habits.label: Crunches ice
clues: A block of ice by the door has hollows gnawed in it, as if someone had been sucking it like a sweet. The culprit crunches ice.
In the night the cook heard loud crunching behind the ice cellar door, as if someone were chewing ice. The culprit crunches ice.

habits.label: Bracelets to the elbow
habits.habit: Wears so many bracelets they cover the arm to the elbow
clues: Beads from a broken bracelet are scattered between the crates. The culprit wears bracelets up to the elbow.
The fur on Happy's wing is pressed into fine ridges, as if grabbed by a hand covered in bracelets. The culprit wears bracelets up to the elbow.

habits.label: Monocle
habits.habit: Wears a monocle on a chain
clues: A cracked monocle lens lies under the stairs to the ice cellar. The culprit wears a monocle.
The porter saw a single lens glint in the dark by the ice cellar door. The culprit wears a monocle.

habits.label: Strums a guitar
habits.habit: Strums a guitar at night and sings their own songs
clues: A snapped guitar string lies next to Happy. The culprit plays the guitar.
The cook heard someone in the corridor by the ice cellar humming "shoobie-doo-bah" in the night. The culprit plays the guitar.

habits.label: Falls asleep anywhere
habits.habit: Can fall asleep standing, sitting or mid-conversation
clues: Someone waited in the ice cellar so long they dozed off on the sacks of salt: there's a dent in them. The culprit falls asleep anywhere.
The porter saw someone fall asleep right on a step down to the ice cellar, then wake up and go down. The culprit falls asleep anywhere.

habits.label: Sequinned jacket
habits.habit: Wears a sequinned jacket even to pop out for bread
clues: Sequins are scattered on the ice cellar steps. The culprit wears a sequinned jacket.
Sequins are caught in Happy's fur: he was clinging to someone. The culprit wears a sequinned jacket.

habits.label: Smells of thunderstorms
habits.habit: Around this person it smells like after a thunderstorm
clues: In the morning the innkeeper went down to the ice cellar, and it smelled of a thunderstorm, though the night was clear. The culprit smells of thunderstorms.
Happy's fur is standing on end, and a crate has a thin scorched stripe, as if from a spark. The culprit smells of thunderstorms.

strong: A fish crate weighing over thirty kilos was pulled away from the wall and put back without leaving a single scrape on the floor. The culprit is physically strong.
The bars on the ice cellar window were bent with bare hands: there's no magic on them, only finger dents. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The night porter sat by the stairs to the ice cellar until morning and swears nobody walked past. The culprit moves silently.
Even asleep, Happy hears the fish barrel being opened in the kitchen. Yet he was carried off sleeping and never got the chance to fly. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The latch on the ice cellar door was altered so it can't be opened from inside, and Happy couldn't get out. The culprit is handy with tools.
The ice cellar door was taken off its hinges and rehung, and the screws have fresh scratches. The culprit is handy with tools.
medic: Happy didn't wake when he was carried downstairs: a sleeping potion was mixed into his evening milk. The culprit knows potions.
Happy's fur has traces of healing salve: someone erased the bruises so no struggle would show. The culprit knows potions.
keys: At night the ice cellar is padlocked. In the morning the padlock was in place and locked, though Happy was inside. The culprit had a key.
The stamp used to put on guild marks is missing from the master's room, and the room was locked all night. The culprit had a key.
safe: A rune is burning out on the ice cellar threshold: anyone who crosses it before dawn forgets what they saw below. The culprit knows how to set runes.
A muffling circle is drawn under the crates: inside it you can't hear a shout or the flap of wings. The culprit knows how to set runes.
sched: Happy was lured downstairs right after the pairings for tomorrow's bouts were brought to the inn, and they arrive at exactly midnight. The culprit knows the routine here.
Every morning at six the innkeeper goes down to the ice cellar for fish for breakfast, and nobody else goes there. The body was meant to be moved by six. The culprit knows the routine here.
tech: The sound lacrima in the ice cellar records the kitchen's orders, but there's only silence on it for tonight: the recording was wiped. The culprit knows their way around lacrimas.
The lacrima lamp over the stairs to the ice cellar went out at exactly two o'clock: someone had charmed it in advance for that time. The culprit knows their way around lacrimas.
cash: The porter admitted he was paid to go to bed early, and paid generously. The money was slipped to him in the dark. The culprit has money.
In the evening someone bought all the fish in the ice cellar from the innkeeper, paid in advance and asked him not to go down until morning. The innkeeper didn't ask a name. The culprit has money.
passages: Behind the crates in the ice cellar wall there's a crawlway into Crocus's old sewers, and its grate was recently moved. The culprit knows the city's secret passages.
Wet footprints lead out of the ice cellar, not to the stairs but to a bricked-up door into the next tavern's cellar. The bricks come out by hand. The culprit knows the city's secret passages.
